note: Compact product catalog for the Coworker's audience-building task. Seeded from src/lib/productCatalogExtras.ts (anonymized copy, industry-shape numbers). target_signals drive fit; disqualifiers are hard risk/underwriting gates that must suppress a household regardless of fit.

products.name: Travel Rewards Card
products.tagline: 1.5x points everywhere, 3x on travel and dining.
products.key_terms: $95 annual fee (waived first year); 3x travel & dining; no foreign transaction fees.

products.name: High-Yield Savings
products.tagline: 4.25% APY on every dollar, no tiers, no caps.
products.key_terms: No monthly fee, $0 minimum; same-day transfers; FDIC-insured.

products.name: 529 Education Savings
products.tagline: Tax-advantaged education savings with age-based glide-paths.
products.key_terms: No account fee; state tax deduction where applicable; beneficiary transferable.

products.name: Term Life Insurance
products.tagline: Term and permanent life coverage sized to dependents and debt.
products.key_terms: Premium by age/coverage/health; 10/20/30-year level term; convertible.

products.name: Home Equity Line of Credit
products.tagline: Draw against home equity, pay interest only on what you use.
products.key_terms: No annual fee; 10-year draw / 20-year repayment; convertible to fixed sub-loans.

products.name: Advisor-Managed Portfolio
products.tagline: Advisor-managed portfolios with planning conversations included.
products.key_terms: 0.85% advisory fee tiered by balance; annual planning review.

products.name: Trust Account
products.tagline: Professional trust administration for estate and legacy plans.
products.key_terms: Annual administration fee tiered by trust value; corporate or co-trustee.

products.name: Home Mortgage
products.tagline: Fixed-rate purchase and refinance with on-app rate lock.

products.name: Homeowner Insurance
products.tagline: Homeowner coverage bundled with auto for a multi-policy discount.
products.key_terms: Replacement-cost dwelling coverage; multi-policy discount; 24/7 claims.

products.name: Student Loan Refinance
products.tagline: Refinance federal and private student debt into one fixed payment.
products.key_terms: Fixed 5.49%-9.99% by profile; 5-20 yr terms; no origination fee.

products.name: Individual Retirement Account
products.tagline: Traditional, Roth, and Rollover IRAs in one account flow.
products.key_terms: $0 account fee; auto contribution scheduler; catch-up unlocks at 50.

products.name: Automated Investing (Robo)
products.tagline: Automated, diversified portfolio matched to your goal and horizon.
products.key_terms: 0.25% advisory fee; auto rebalancing and tax-loss harvesting; no minimum.

products.name: Overdraft Protection
products.tagline: Link a savings or line of credit to cover the occasional shortfall.
products.key_terms: $0 transfer fee from linked savings; decline-instead option; low-balance alerts.
